## Where we stand
- **Sales:** Bugaboo sold AUD 29.1M in FY2026 to date, at a 36.9% margin. The category makes 37.6%, so Bugaboo is 0.7 pts below it.
- **Growth and share:** Sales are down 5.4%, while the category is down 2.9%. Share is 32.5%, down 0.9 pts. Bugaboo still ranks first of 5 brands, so the category depends on it.
- **Promotions:** Baby Mart gave AUD 913,394 of promotional discount. Each AUD 1 of discount returned AUD 0.94 of margin, and % Off promotions did best.
- **Switching:** Net switching is −8. Uppababy is the main destination: 172 customers moved to it.
- **DIFOT:** Bugaboo Pacific has delivered 71.9% in full and on time since 6 April, against a 96% target.
  - 17 of the 18 missed lines are the supplier's.
  - The other line was Baby Mart's own ordering, so it is not the supplier's failure.
  - No stores are short.



## The asks
| Ask | Opening | Target | Walk-away |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 Close the 0.7 pt margin gap | AUD 236,027 | AUD 141,616 | AUD 59,007 |
| A2 Supplier co-funds 50% of promo discount | AUD 527,739 | AUD 316,643 | AUD 131,935 |
| A3 DIFOT credit (3% of missed deliveries) | AUD 7,360 | AUD 4,416 | AUD 0 |
| A4 Waive charge on our 1 line (give) | AUD 0 | AUD 496 | AUD 496 |
| **Totals (asks less gives)** | **AUD 771,126** | **AUD 462,179** | **AUD 190,446** |

The only give is AUD 496.

## How to play it
1. **Open with delivery.** Lead with the DIFOT record: 71.9% against 96%, with the supplier responsible for 17 of the 18 misses. Use it to ask for the A3 credit, then put A2 promo co-funding on the table. A2 is the largest ask.
2. **Trade on margin.** Press A1, and offer the A4 waiver on our own missed line in return for movement on A1 or A2.
3. **Close with the levers.** Propose a joint growth plan to win back share, and keep Uppababy in reserve as the alternative. If you need to, give up the A3 credit in exchange for an allocation commitment.

## Watch outs
- **Our own miss:** Don't count the line we caused as Bugaboo's failure. Our inflated orders caused it.
- **Category dependence:** Bugaboo is 32.5% of the category, so a balanced stance makes more sense than threats.
- **Mild alternative:** Net switching is only −8, so Uppababy is a modest lever rather than a strong threat.
- **Promo returns:** Promotions return less margin than they cost in discount, which supports the co-funding ask. Expect Bugaboo to push back on the 50% share.

This brief is a draft. A category manager needs to approve it on the Negotiation brief page.
